note: CICO witnesses recovered by the subgroup-interpolation resultant on registered t = 16 Poseidon reductions. Each entry gives the two surviving free inputs; the other twelve are Specialization::<46, K>::seeded(2..14, seed) and are therefore reproducible rather than recorded. Every entry is re-checked through CicoInstance::is_solution, which runs permutation_plus_linear, by grobner::research::resultant::tests::test_the_recorded_witnesses_verify_through_the_permutation. The six-round entry was recovered on 32 determinant workers and reproduced identically on a second independent run; the worker count affects only the wall clock, so it is not part of the witness and is recorded in the run file rather than here.
